about.title: A Saudi systems integrator built on engineering rigour.
about.lead: Convergent Technology Company designs, builds, operates, and maintains the technology behind Saudi enterprises. Headquartered in Al Khobar, organised as a group of four specialist business units.
about.missionBody: To deliver the technology infrastructure behind the institutions that move Saudi Arabia forward — engineered to last, operated to spec, and accountable end-to-end.
about.valuesBody: Engineering rigour. Vendor-neutral counsel. Disciplined commercial conduct. Long-term operational accountability.
